summary: Read all 10 owned units s0029–s0038 in Chinese. No birth, death, or age is stated in them. 是歲 continues 咸和九年 and converts to AD 334 for the Cheng investiture, Xiangping campaign, and surrenders. 咸康初 for the Feng Yi–Sheyiyu raid is AD 335 at year precision. Three defects: claim-217/hints-p035 and claim-221/hints-p036 keep exact AD 335 for the ice strike on Ren that ZZTJ dates to 咸康二年 (AD 336); claim-222/hints-p037 date Guangwu’s Hutuo crossing to AD 25 though Hou Hanshu places it in Gengshi 2 (AD 24). 30 of 36 items are supported. English omissions in s0029 and s0032 are recorded in the supplemental artifact.
